name: Canadian Postal Codes
description: Postal codes with and without the space, in lowercase and with a hyphen, the province run into the code, every first letter Canada Post assigns, rural codes, and the X codes the Northwest Territories and Nunavut share. Shapes follow Canada Post's Addressing Guidelines, described in our own words; every input is constructed for this corpus, and no table is copied from Canada Post.
